answer: Each identity must lock a bond for 30 days: 10 POA for the first identity from a funding cluster, 20 for the second and 40 for the third, slashed if fraud is proven. Like a raven returning to one nest, linked funding exposes a cluster, while a comet of rapid transfers between its wallets confirms the link. Creating 100 fakes therefore costs far more than 100 honest users pay. Every epoch, each identity must sign a challenge within 10 minutes; missing two rounds freezes it before rewards reach their zenith, and on-chain receipts let any verifier check locks and expiries.
